# Made Yoga Mahardika

> Personal site of Made Yoga Mahardika, a fullstack software developer based in Samarinda, Indonesia.

## Site

- [Home](https://madeyoga.harten.id/): Profile, open-source work, and current experiments
- [Blog](https://madeyoga.harten.id/blog): Notes on .NET, Nuxt, Django, and AI tooling
- [Projects](https://madeyoga.harten.id/projects): Open-source libraries and client work
- [AuthEndpoints docs](https://authendpoints.harten.id/): Documentation for the ASP.NET Core auth library
